label: Text With Icon
purpose: Up to 3 short icon + text pairs in one item, inside a horizontal ticker
_notes:
text_N is inline_richtext (no

tags) — a short phrase, not a sentence. The block's icons and layout are fixed by the base theme's seed (this block only ever appears inside horizontal-ticker's fixed_blocks list) — write only text_1/text_2/text_3 for whichever of the seed's slots have text, never an icon_N. Distinct from text-with-icon (hyphenated) used elsewhere — this one is horizontal-ticker's own version.
